recent_module_findings.OSReset.c: Complete 16/16 (2026-10-02). 5 functions matched as plain C; fn_805F6CF0, __OSStateEventHandler and PlayRecordCallback needed matching asm. Evidence that the retail RVL-SDK OS library was built with a different MWCC revision than the game code compiled here: retail lowers a dense 7-case switch to a jump table (this compiler's threshold is 8 cases) and keeps branch-style boolean materialisation, which this compiler if-converts at every optimisation level. Verify with tools/verify_osreset.py.
